payload.purpose_context: A file name reused across pack layers with a different declared id silently changes which id that name stands for; validate and doctor must report it (issue #6743).
payload.purpose_tldr: Report a pack file-name collision across layers as a pack-content error in validate and doctor

payload.wp_title: Doctor reports the collision across the chain
